en: Using Pi efficiently starts by embracing its
extensibility.
You know, Pi by default is very minimal.
It only has a few built-in tools that allow
it to roam the file system, read files, edit
files, delete files, and so on,
and also to use your Bash, so your terminal,
which make it really powerful.
But it's also extensible, and we'll dive
into how you can build your own extensions
and let Pi
enhance itself, which is super amazing later
in the course. But as a first step, you can
also use some
packages, some extensions built by other
people. And you should absolutely take a
look at that because there are some packages
out there that can really make Py
quite a bit more powerful than it is out of
the box. So that's what we'll explore now.
